cards.name: 🛒 Vendas
cards.desc:
- Estoque: GET /products/{id} → tabelas: products, categories, suppliers
- RH: GET /employees/{id} → tabelas: employees, territories, employee_territories
- Financeiro: POST /payments/validate → tabelas: transactions, payments
- Manager: gRPC notifyOrderCreated(orderId) → logs para auditoria e relatórios

cards.name: 📦 Estoque
cards.desc:
- Não consome dados de outros serviços inicialmente
- Endpoints oferecidos:
  • GET /products → products, categories, suppliers
  • GET /products/{id} → products
  • POST /products → products
  • PUT /products/{id} → products
- gRPC: getProductInfo(productId), updateStock(productId, quantityChange)

cards.name: 👥 RH
cards.desc:
- Não consome dados de outros serviços inicialmente
- Endpoints oferecidos:
  • GET /employees → employees, territories, employee_territories
  • GET /employees/{id} → employees, territories
  • POST /employees → employees
  • PUT /employees/{id} → employees
- gRPC: getEmployeeById(id), notifyEmployeeChange(id)

cards.name: 💰 Financeiro
cards.desc:
- Vendas: GET /orders/{id} → tabelas: orders, order_details, customers
- Manager: gRPC sendTransactionLog(transactionId) → auditoria
- Endpoints oferecidos:
  • POST /payments → transactions, invoices, payments
  • GET /payments/{id} → transactions, payments
  • PUT /payments/{id} → transactions, payments

cards.name: 🧠 Manager
cards.desc:
- Vendas: gRPC notifyOrderCreated(orderId)
- Financeiro: gRPC sendTransactionLog(transactionId)
- RH: gRPC getEmployeeById(id) para relatórios de performance
- Estoque: gRPC getProductInfo(productId) opcional para relatórios consolidados
- Endpoints oferecidos:
  • GET /reports/summary → integra Vendas, Estoque, Financeiro
  • GET /reports/employees → integra Vendas, RH
